parameters.description: An ID of kind agent, made by the engine.

parameters.description: An ID of kind agent, made by the engine.

parameters.description: An ID of kind actor, made by the engine.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: An ID of kind actor, made by the engine.

delete.summary: Deletes an archived actor and its subagents, with their conversations and the images and files only they had. What they cost stays in the usage.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: An ID of kind actor, made by the engine.

post.summary: Archives an actor: it takes no input until it is unarchived.

parameters.description: An ID of kind actor, made by the engine.

post.summary: Unarchives an actor.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: An ID of kind actor, made by the engine.

post.summary: Ends the turn an actor is in. What waits in its mailbox stays.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: An ID of kind actor, made by the engine.

post.summary: Stops everything an actor is doing: its turn and its tasks. What waited in its mailbox starts no turn.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: An ID of kind actor, made by the engine.

post.summary: Compacts an actor's conversation now, whatever its size. Between turns only. Nothing is compacted when nothing is new.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: An ID of kind actor, made by the engine.

get.summary: Lists the compactions of an actor's conversation, newest first.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: An ID of kind actor, made by the engine.

post.summary: Has an actor whose last turn failed try it again.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: An ID of kind actor, made by the engine.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: An ID of kind actor, made by the engine.

get.summary: Lists what an actor was sent, newest first: what waits in its mailbox, and what a turn took.

parameters.description: An ID of kind actor, made by the engine.

parameters.description: An ID of kind actor, made by the engine.

parameters.description: An ID of kind actor, made by the engine.

parameters.description: An ID of kind actor, made by the engine.

parameters.description: An ID of kind actor, made by the engine.

parameters.description: An ID of kind actor, made by the engine.

parameters.description: An ID of kind machine, made by the engine.

parameters.description: An ID of kind machine, made by the engine.

parameters.description: An ID of kind machine, made by the engine.

parameters.description: An ID of kind machine, made by the engine.

parameters.description: An ID of kind machine, made by the engine.

parameters.description: An ID of kind machine, made by the engine.

parameters.description: An ID of kind machine, made by the engine.

post.summary: Stops a command of a machine's own, and answers once it has ended.

parameters.name: machine
parameters.description: An ID of kind machine, made by the engine.

get.summary: Reads the bytes of a file of a machine, as they are. `x-file-size` says how large the file is.

parameters.name: machine
parameters.description: An ID of kind machine, made by the engine.

parameters.description: An ID of kind machine, made by the engine.

parameters.description: An ID of kind machine, made by the engine.
